summary: Inline pixel sparkline with a dithered area, coloured green or red by trend unless a colour is set; hovering shows the value.

props.name: data
props.description: The series. Non-finite entries (`NaN`, `Infinity`) are dropped, and fewer than two values draw nothing. A change replays the draw-in.

props.name: label
props.description: Start of the canvas `aria-label`, followed by the first, last, lowest and highest value.

props.name: color
props.description: Line colour. Without it the line is `success` when the last value is at least the first, otherwise `destructive`.

props.name: unit
props.description: Text appended to every value as written, in the hover value and the `aria-label`; include a leading space for a spaced unit such as `" ms"`.

accessibility: The canvas has `role="img"` and an `aria-label` that summarises the series, for example "Trend: from 4 to 13, low 4, high 13".
The hover value is pointer-only and `aria-hidden`; keyboard and assistive technology users get the summary in the `aria-label`.
motion: With reduced motion the line appears at once instead of drawing in from the left.
notes: The sample series `4, 6, 5, 8, 7, 9, 8, 12, 10, 13` is drawn when `data` is not set.
It renders inline (`inline-block`, aligned to the middle), so it sits in table cells and running text.

data.note: Pass your series as `data`. Without it the sparkline shows an invented sample series.
